rtl_system_rules.text_alignment: right by default for Arabic content
rtl_system_rules.number_formatting: LTR for numbers, amounts (SAR), phone numbers, dates, IBANs using dir='ltr' inline wrappers
rtl_system_rules.flex_grid_direction: Natural flex/grid in RTL mode (flex-row-reverse where required or relying on CSS dir='rtl')
rtl_system_rules.icon_flip_rules: Flip directional arrows (chevron-left points right for forward flow in Arabic). Do NOT flip universal icons like search, wallet, truck, or checkmarks
rtl_system_rules.spacing_logical_props: Use me-*, ms-*, ps-*, pe-* instead of mr-*, ml-*

landing_page_structure: Hero Header with Glassmorphism Nav (Logo 'إسناد', Quick Nav, Role Selector CTA)
Hero Banner with Modern Saudi Urban/Logistics Backdrop, Dynamic Punchy Headline, Live Marketplace Metrics Badge
Services Grid (6 Key Services: Delivery Couriers, Warehouse Staff, Loading/Unloading, Inventory Sorting, Fleet Cars With/Without Drivers, Temporary Event Operations)
How It Works Flow (Company Creates Request -> AI/Instant Worker Matching -> Attendance Tracking & Escrow Wallet Protection)
Interactive Estimate Calculator (Select service type, duration, worker quantity -> Instant SAR estimate)
Trust & Compliance Banner (Saudi Vision 2030 support, CR Verification, SAMA-compliant Escrow Wallets, Attendance Geo-fencing)
Dual Role Onboarding CTA Cards (Company Registration / Worker Service Provider)
Footer with Platform Links, Regional Hubs (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, NEOM), Contact Support & Regulatory Disclosures

business_dashboard: Header with Wallet Balance (SAR), Escrow Hold, Active Requests Counter, Urgent Replacement Alerts
Create Service Request Wizard (4-step modal or dedicated view: Service Selection -> Duration/Vehicle Specs -> Location/Schedule -> Cost Breakdown & Escrow Fund)
Active Requests Matrix Table with Status Chips, Confirmed Worker Details, Geo Attendance Status, Replacement Request trigger
worker_dashboard: Worker Status Switch (متاح للعمل Now / غير متاح), Wallet Available Earnings (SAR), Completed Jobs Rating
Available Opportunities Feed with Full Details Before Accepting (Location, Duration, Daily/Hourly Rate, Service Category, Company Name)
Accepted Jobs & Today's Shift Card with Attendance Confirmation Button (تسجيل الحضور الجغرافي)
Earnings Wallet with Direct Withdrawal Requests (IBAN)
admin_dashboard: Platform KPI Overview (Total SAR Volume, Active Companies, Registered Service Providers, Shift Completion Rate)
Request Matching & Manual Worker Dispatch Board

instructions_to_main_agent: Always wrap interactive components with data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='create-request-btn', data-testid='worker-accept-job-1', data-testid='wallet-topup-input').
Ensure dir='rtl' is active on the html element or main wrapper, and use IBM Plex Sans Arabic for body text and Tajawal for headers.
Implement real mock data state in local storage or React context so requests created by companies instantly pop up on the Worker Job Feed and Admin Dispatch view.
Support full role switching between Business, Worker, and Admin for demonstration without friction.
Never use raw transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or modals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize smooth micro-animations using Framer Motion or Tailwind transitions.
Keep contrast ratios high: dark navy background (#0B132B / #0F172A) with vivid Emerald (#00E5A3) and Amber (#F59E0B) accents.
Strictly follow Arabic RTL layout patterns without breaking LTR format for numbers and IBANs.
